sparkline.description: Inline SVG trend line for a bound series of numbers, auto-scaled with an optional last-value label.

gauge.description: Semi-circular arc gauge for a single value against a min/max range.

status.description: A colored status dot next to a label: ok, warn, or down.

uptime.description: Segmented bar showing a history of ok/warn/down states, oldest first.

delta.description: An up or down triangle with a formatted change value.
